name: Tilt-out bin unit, 9 bins, 600 mm wide
description:
A tilt-out bin unit (Hebrew: רב-תא, "multi-cell") with 9 bins side by side: a fixed open-front housing in which each bin pivots forward on its bottom edge, so small parts can be seen and reached without removing anything. This is the 9-bin member of a range that shares one 600 mm (23 5/8 in) width, so units of different bin counts stack into a single wall; only height and depth change.

External dimensions: depth 62 mm, width 600 mm, height 77 mm.

No formal standard. Metric and US ranges share one 600 mm (23 5/8 in) width with 2/3/4/5/6/9-bin units, so units of different bin counts stack into one wall. Matches Akro-Mils TiltView 0670N.

GLB (glTF 2.0), real-world scale in metres, origin at the centre of the base. 4,144 triangles, flat PBR base colours, no textures. CC BY 4.0.
summary: Tilt-out bin unit, 9 bins, 62 x 600 x 77 mm - true-scale GLB of a 600 mm wide multi-cell tilt-bin housing for shelving and parts storage.
